headline: Mid-table sides topple the top two
dek: Rollins beat Florida Tech on Tuesday, a day after Tampa won at Embry-Riddle. Both winners finished their ten conference matches on fourteen points, nine behind Florida Tech and five behind Embry-Riddle, each of whom lost once in conference play.
displaced_by: Rollins beat table leaders Florida Tech a day after Tampa won at Embry-Riddle, so both of the table's top two have now been beaten.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Florida Southern have outscored every other programme, but goals have not settled the table: Florida Tech lead it on a total from the middle of the pack.

wire.line: Rollins, mid-table in the conference, have beaten leaders Florida Tech and go to Lynn next.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Palm Beach Atlantic's home matches against Florida Atlantic, Barry and Strive Academy, and Eckerd's home match against Trinity in September, have all passed their date with no result.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Kobi Thomas has scored eighteen of Palm Beach Atlantic's 30 goals this season, from 64 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Finlay Prain has scored sixteen of Rollins' 32 goals this season, from 73 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Marcos da Silva has kept five clean sheets for Embry-Riddle.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Nova Southeastern have conceded 34 goals, more than any other programme in the conference.

last_match.line: The sides drew on this ground in October; Rollins go to Lynn next.

next_match.line: These sides drew at Florida Southern in October; Tampa arrive having won at Embry-Riddle.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
